WITH telescope_weather_groups AS (
  SELECT
    t.telescregistry,
    o.weathprofile,
    AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modindex,
    AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshift
  FROM signals AS s
  JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
  JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS mean_group_avg_modindex
  FROM telescope_weather_groups
),
kept_groups AS (
  SELECT g.*
  FROM telescope_weather_groups AS g
  CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
  WHERE g.avg_modindex > b.mean_group_avg_modindex
)
SELECT
  weathprofile,
  AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex,
  AVG(avg_phaseshift) AS avg_phaseshift,
  AVG(avg_modindex - b.mean_group_avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex_above_baseline
FROM kept_groups
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
GROUP BY weathprofile;

assumptions.assumption: The baseline is the unweighted mean of all telescope/weather group average modulation indices; NULL group averages are excluded by AVG, as in standard SQL.
